observations.body: The interpreted statue places successive kingdoms beside a kingdom established by the God of heaven.
observations.label: A kingdom that will not be destroyed

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside a kingdom that will not be destroyed.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Daniel 2:35–46 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the interpreted statue places successive kingdoms beside a kingdom established by the God of heaven. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: A kingdom that will not be destroyed
